name: Gamblers Lab
desc: A gambler's-ruin lab: start, goal and win-probability sliders drive the ruin probability (q/p)^i, expected duration and a 50-walk simulation.
controls: Start, goal and win-probability sliders, four presets (fair/unfair/favorable/long shot), simulate and reset buttons; keys 1–4 load presets, Space simulates, R resets
creator: Original build (Dragon Gaming Assets)
